analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($1.00) vs SMA5 ($1.01)/SMA20 ($1.04)/SMA50 ($1.08) — below, indicating weak short-to-medium term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($1.17)/SMA200 ($1.29) — below, maintaining strong long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (0.5%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.2→34.8) — entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -0.0051→-0.0039) — improving, signaling bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $0.98) — approaching lower band, with band width narrowing to 11.22%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.58) — Pivot S1 ($0.95) acting as short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($1.13) — Bollinger upper band ($1.10) acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $0.99, 20-day low $0.99) — continuing sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.40x) — contracted volume, reducing reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — maintain observation, consider selling if 52-week low of $0.99 is breached.
